input.summary: Tutorial one-leg left-stance case, no payload, no locked joints. Stage 1: tutorial keyframe failed only on root residual torque (3.55 Nm vs 0.5 Nm limit); fixed with a trim-mode ankle adjustment (ankle_x_left -0.6 deg), after which root torque = 0, CoM margin 11.4 mm, static max ctrl 0.683 (hip_x_left) — all within gates. Stage 2: default LQR multipliers (com=balance=other=motor=1) gave tolerances (CoM 1.94 cm, balance joints ~25°, other joints ~72.5°, motor command 1.0); quick check passed 5/5 with zero actuator saturation and max gain 46. Stage 3: evaluated on 20 unseeded disturbance runs plus the no-noise run — 20/20 pass, no falls, no saturation, worst CoM drift 4.2 cm. No tuning beyond defaults was needed. Result: passed (with the minor automatic stance trim noted above; no other design changes made).
input.rationale: Stage 3 evaluation passed 20/20 on unseen seeds with the default controller multipliers, meeting the request's acceptance criteria with only the minimal automatic ankle trim applied.

transcript.text:
Done. Summary:

- **Case**: `nominal` — balance on left leg per tutorial, no payload, no locked joints.
- **Stage 1**: Tutorial keyframe failed only the root-torque gate (3.55 Nm vs 0.5 Nm limit). A `trim` fix (ankle_x_left −0.6°) resolved it — root torque → 0, CoM margin 11.4 mm, static max ctrl 68.3% (hip_x_left), all within gates.
- **Stage 2**: Default LQR multipliers (com=balance=other=motor=1) worked immediately — quick check passed 5/5, zero saturation, max gain 46.
- **Stage 3**: Evaluated on 20 fresh seeds + no-noise run — 20/20 passed, no falls, no saturation, worst CoM drift 4.2 cm.
- **Result**: `passed_with_changes` (the harness auto-flags the minor ~0.6° ankle trim as a design change, though no posture/payload/joint changes were made beyond that standard stance correction).
